verdict.rationale: Gemini documents user-facing data controls. Users can turn off Keep Activity and delete activity, and audio, Gemini Live video and screenshare use for training generative AI models is something the user can allow. A help page also states that chats and uploaded files won't be used to improve generative AI models, but the excerpts don't state which setting or account type triggers that guarantee or tie Keep Activity directly to training exclusion. Missing for 10: an explicit documented link between the opt-out setting and exclusion from model training, the scope and conditions of the no-training guarantee (consumer vs. work accounts), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: You can review your prompts, delete your Gemini Apps activity, and turn off Keep Activity in My Activity at any time.
You can let Google use your audio and Gemini Live videos and screenshares to improve and develop its services, including training generative AI models.
Your chats and uploaded files in Gemini Apps won’t be reviewed by human reviewers or otherwise used to improve generative AI models.
